## Rule

**Count the N solid 2×2 red (color-2) blocks; render N as a dice-pip pattern on a fixed 3×3
output.** Pip cells light in order (0,0),(0,2),(1,1),(2,0),(2,2); cell k lights iff N≥k.
Verified N=1..5 across all 8 train + 3 test pairs. Output is ALWAYS 3×3; input is a variable
N×N grid. Content-dependent count→render — NOT a shape-only / identity / transpose transform.

**LIVE = cost 43** (manifest owner Vamshi, sha `10881f0d…`), NOT the stale 1,377 crop-graph in
the AUTO block above. The 43-graph: `Einsum(nchw,c->n)` one-hot@2 selector → 4N scalar; `Cast`
i8; `Sub` odd-threshold patch `[3,127,7,127,11,127,15,127,19]`; `ConvInteger` weight
`[10,1,1,1]=[-1,1,0…]` (free `pads` attr) → 10-ch one-hot. Odd thresholds are load-bearing
(4N is always even ⇒ `4N−thr`≠0 ⇒ decoder's "exactly one channel >0" always resolves).

## Cost analysis

Cost 43 = memory 14 (red_f32 4 + red_i8 1 + signed_patch 9) + params 29
(red_selector 10 + thresholds 9 + channel_weights 10). **All three initializers are at their
floor:** (1) Einsum contracts the length-10 channel axis ⇒ selector must be 10 elems; any
cheaper selector materialises a plane/vector intermediate costing MORE memory than params saved.
(2) 3×3 pip geometry needs 9 threshold cells (5 pips + 4 blockers@127), not separable. (3) The
visible gate compares raw output to [1,10,30,30] one-hot ⇒ output must be 10-ch ⇒ 1×1
ConvInteger weight is [10,1,1,1]=10 params (zeros still counted). Forced-floor lower bound
≈ 29 params + ~11 B ≈ 40; achieved 43. profile_real_cost = 43 (static==profile). **WALL.**
